text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: latency.p99_eu > 750ms (5m window) — PD-8765 — https://pagerduty.example/PD-8765

alice: acked — I'm oncall and looking now :wave:

sanjay: pulling Grafana dashboards (eu-cluster /tokenizer /inference) — gfy: https://grafana.example/d/xyz

olivia: seeing sustained p99 on /v1/generate, p95 creeping up too. Errors still low but tail latency high

ram: pushed a small tokenizer micro-optimization ~12m ago, can confirm canary traffic at 10%

alice: canary -> rollback? what's the traffic split and error rate on those canaries?

sanjay: canary hosts look saturated: GPU mem ~92%, OOMs none. Autoscaler didn't spin up new nodes (min=3, current=3). Request queue depth increased on sidecar.

olivia: quick mitigation: route heavy inference to fallback smaller-quantized model (latency tradeoff but lowers p99). Anyone able to flip routing?

alice: running routing change now (EU only). Command: ```
POST /ops/routing/switch
{"region":"eu","policy":"fallback-small-quant"}
```

alice: response: {"status":"ok","applied_to":"eu","new_split":"primary:20%,fallback:80%"} :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by alice (PD-8765)

ram: warming KV cache on a couple of nodes to reduce cold prefix cost — kickoff script running: `./tools/warm_kv --region eu --hosts host[12-13]`

sanjay: telemetry update: p99 -> 420ms (was 820ms) within 3m of routing flip, p95 -> 110ms. Queue depth dropping.

olivia: customer impact check: 0.7% elevated latency errors (timeout retries) in last 5m, no widespread 5xx. Drafting short customer advisory for affected EU tenants.

alice: good mitigation. I'll keep the routing change for now and continue monitoring. Logging runbook actions under incident PD-8765. Handing off to eve for the next 30m observation window — @eve you'll take watch?

eve: on it, thanks. will monitor dashboards and revert routing once stable. Please post any rollback if tail resurfaces.

alice: quick note for postmortem: investigate autoscaler thresholds (GPU mem high but no scale), consider pre-warming for canary rollouts and KV warmup integration.

incident-bot: PD note: PD-8765 marked acknowledged; escalation suppressed.

sanjay: leaving a checkpoint: current p99 390–450ms, p95 steady ~105–130ms. No further alerts for 10m.

olivia: added incident tags: region:eu, mitigation:routing-fallback, suspected-cause:canary-hotpath

alice: resolving active paging for now — continuing watch. Will open a follow-up ticket for autoscale+canary changes. :white_check_mark:

eve: thanks — will update if any regression.

alice: closing thread in 30m if metrics remain stable.
